description: Leatherwork is a hands-on craft badge: tool safety and first aid, where leather comes from and its types, leather projects using a range of techniques, braiding, and exploring tanning, leather care or a leather business.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Safety and first aid
requirements.summary: Hazards of leatherwork tools and materials, and first aid for cuts, punctures and chemical reactions.

requirements.title: Leather and hides
requirements.summary: Where leather comes from, the hides used and the main types of leather.

requirements.title: Leather projects
requirements.summary: Making leather items that use several techniques, such as cutting, stamping, dyeing and lacing.

requirements.title: Braiding
requirements.summary: Braiding or plaiting with leather, vinyl lace or paracord.

requirements.title: Exploring leather
requirements.summary: One option, such as researching tanning, tanning a hide, restoring leather goods or visiting a leather business.
